summary: # Headless CMS Guide Reference for choosing, modeling, and implementing a headless CMS for marketing content. ## When to Use This Reference Use this when selecting a CMS for a new project, designing content models for marketing sites, setting up editorial workflows, or connecting CMS content to programmatic pages. --- ## Headless vs Traditional CMS A headless CMS separates content management from presentation. Content is stored in a structured backend and delivered via API to any frontend. ### When Headless Makes Sense - Multiple frontends consume the same content (web, mobile, email) - Developers want full control over the frontend stack
